pages.title: Loom-stitchers
pages.text:
The Loom-stitchers cut the gate-paths — into the March, into the Nether and End, into places the map does not have words for — and always meant to come back and mend them.

They did not get to. You will.

pages.title: Spindle Strand
pages.text:
*The Loom was never one thread. It was nine agreeing.*

Seated. The Loom-stitchers answer when this Post hums.
